import pandas as pd

# Read input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot to wide format:
# - index: city_id, city_name, year (identifier columns)
# - columns: indicator_id (one column per indicator)
# - values: value (the indicator value)
pivoted = df.pivot(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'], 
    columns='indicator_id', 
    values='value'
)

# Reset index to get flat row structure with city_id, city_name, year as columns
matrix = pivoted.reset_index()

# Select only the identifier columns (city_id, city_name, year) plus the indicator columns
# The indicator columns are the pivot columns (indicator_id values)
# Keep indicator_name and unit columns as well for completeness
columns_to_keep = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + list(pivoted.columns)
matrix = matrix[columns_to_keep]

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
matrix.to_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
